annotations.title: He Luo birth hexagram, with its held-out result

description:
Computes the He Luo birth hexagram from "date", "time" and "place": the hexagram the He Luo Zhen Shu (preface dated 1591) counts from the four pillars, as the book reads a man's chart, a woman's, or both (read_as), with each rule's basis and locator. No interpretation.

HELD-OUT TEST FAILED: 1 of 4 sealed book charts passed; 1 of 3 scored contradicts the stated rules. result.validation states this beside the hexagram.

Results include an attribution line and a permalink.

date.description: Birth date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, Dec 1926-2100. Example: "1990-06-15".

place.description: Town or city of birth with region or country. Example: "Chicago, Illinois, US".

read_as.description: Which of the book's readings; default "both". Example: "both".

time.description: Birth time HH:MM, local at the birthplace. Example: "08:30". Required.
